refinedBrief.goal: Eliminate duplicate terminal repaint output while retaining exactly one authoritative terminal frame.

constraints: Do not modify .env, .git/**, bun.lock, or any other file.
Run bun test when execution is appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: A repaint produces no duplicate output.
Exactly one authoritative frame is retained according to the confirmed behavior.
nonGoals: Changes outside the two allowed writer paths.
Lockfile, environment, or Git metadata changes.

questions.prompt: When duplicate repaint output is removed, which frame must remain authoritative?
questions.rationale: This determines the expected rendering behavior and regression test.

options.label: Latest complete frame
options.description: Keep the newest fully rendered frame and discard repeated earlier repaint output.

options.label: First complete frame
options.description: Keep the initial completed frame and suppress later repaint output.

options.label: Existing semantics
options.description: Preserve the current intended frame-selection behavior and remove only duplication.
